steps.content:
<color=#7683a2>[9th Agency Top-Secret Archive Excerpt-1]
The origins of Subject S-247 are untraceable. Current hypothesis suggests he may be an anomalous entity spawned from Black Ring influence.

<color=#7683a2>The Agency employed advanced interrogation techniques, including psychological induction protocols from Banyan Medical College and deep-trance hypnosis, to extract information.
The resulting data, however, proved too fragmented and contradictory to synthesize into a credible history.
<i>The shackles appear to... resonate with certain memories. To be honest, I rarely looked back before this. I can hardly recall things clearly anymore.<i>

<i>Every time I wake up in a fresh body, I feel something has slipped away, while something else... has seeped in. It makes a certain sense. The flesh is just a vessel for memory. A vessel I can never hold onto for long.<i>
<i>But one thing never changes. Every single time I retrace this fragmented path, I always see the same things.<i>
<i>It always starts with a Black Ring. And it always ends as a joke.<i>
[Scene Change] [Flashback] BR-001
<color=#fb9259><size=50>N.F. 89, DisCity Carnival</color>
<color=#fb9259><size=50>The BR-001 Outbreak</color>

steps.speaker: DisCity Visitor A
steps.content: AAAAAHHH!! What is that?? The amusement park is... is... MONSTERS!!

steps.speaker: DisCity Child
steps.content: Mommy... Daddy... Waaaaaah—
That day, fear and despair had spread like wildfire, assimilating all prey too weak to flee and transforming them into Corruptors. Humans, helpless, had run only in vain.

Yet against the tide of fleeing crowds, several figures in black raincoats were striding calmly forward, their faces upturned in worship of the twisted red glow that rose above. Amid the cacophony of wailing dirges, it slowly unfurled into the shape of a ring.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: A wild fragment... To unleash such power without guidance, without any Mania catalyst...

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: The Ring... As the prophecy foretold, the halo descends... This is divinity's true face. A miracle born from a mere fragment... Can we replicate such grace? How? The park is sealed now. We...
When he turned to ask, his companion offered no reply. Instead, he found the other crouched low, prodding at a creature nestled among the debris and rubble.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: ...How's this little swine still breathing? Scraps the spawns overlooked?

He crouched and seized the child's head, forcing it to turn. The child didn't cry or flinch; he was hollow, like a shell from which the soul had been emptied, the dried tracks of salt tears still visible on his cheeks.
Was he six years old... or only five? The child lay curled in a hollow, completely motionless, clutching a bloodstained adult shoe to his chest.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: Brain not fully formed? Consciousness too faint to register, I suppose. Leave it. It'll be dead in days.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: ...I'll take him back.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: Hah? Oh, spare me, you senile fool! Has the Overground stench rotted your mind? Why waste breath on that thing?

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: ...Alive all these days, and can bear the Ring's gaze... This one is favored. Might be of use.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: ...Since when do swine and mutts earn the Ring's favor? Fine. Have it your way. You always have a soft spot for strays.
<i><color=#7683a2>...Don't call me that...</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>Favor...? I want no part of its curse...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: Come here, brat. That's it, come. No one's coming for you. Come with us, to the Underground sanctuary. There's a god down there who can keep you safe.
<i><color=#7683a2>It took everything... Why would I seek its shelter?</color><i>

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: If you wish to live... come with me...
<i><color=#7683a2>...Was it because... I didn't want to die?</color><i>
<i>That was my first encounter with a Black Ring. I didn't die there... I was taken, by ones from the Underground.<i>
<i>For the next decade, they became my family.<i>

<color=#7683a2>[9th Agency Top-Secret Archive Excerpt-2]
Subject S-247 was captured in N.F. 106 from the observatory ruins, found within the wreckage of the Black Ring. He exhibits an exceptionally high tolerance to Black Ring contamination. All corruption-based experiments to date have failed to fully degrade or terminate the subject.
He retains a semblance of sanity: the barest, most tenuous level of cognitive cohesion.

<color=#7683a2>Analysis of internal tissue samples confirms contamination from multiple distinct Black Ring signatures:
- Most Recent: BR-003
- Earliest: BR-001
- Peak Concentration: BR-000, or a contaminant nearly identical to BR-000
- Trace Amounts: BR-002

Home, to him, had always meant darkness, confinement, oppression, and gloom. He had been hidden away in a small drainage trench, kept out of sight of the believers who flowed to and from ■■. They, too, were hiding in this sunless sewer city, sheltering from the sinful light of the world above.
Down there, a person's world was only as wide as their vision. But that hadn't mattered much.
For the brat, it was enough simply to have a "home." Wherever his "family" was, that had been his "home."

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Five centimeters taller, a thousand hymns sung... It's been a thousand days. You scrawny mutt, you must be eight by now.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Useless brat! Eight years old and you still don't act like a proper believer!
...Then why not just throw me out?
Those words earned him a slap across the face.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Still using that filthy Overground swine-speak, are you? When you speak to me, you speak like a proper human!

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content:
Throw you out? I could just as easily kill you. But if you're gone, who's going to pay back the seven hundred days of food I wasted on you?
Catch!

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: ...Memorize every step. I fought hard to get you this chance. Do this right, and you can finally scrub that Overground stink off for good. I'll bring you into ■■, and you won't have to hide in the outer ditches anymore...

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Do it right! It's the only thing you're good for. Mess this up, and I'll get myself some real dogs instead, and butcher you to feed them!
<i><color=#7683a2>Just like that, I was back on the surface. A thousand days later, I saw the sun again, sent to execute my first "mission."</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>The "god" wanted to open a door that would not yield to it. So it ordered me to steal the key.</color><i>

N.F. 104
Inner Bay, West District, DisCity
Before the Mine W-31 Negotiation

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: ...Help... Help... me...

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: Hey! Where'd you come from, kid? You're nothing but skin and bones. An Outlander? My goodness... you're white as chalk! And you're freezing!

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: Get in here. Come on, quick now. Don't you go dying on me.
<i><color=#7683a2>It had been so long since I'd seen the "swine" the Undergrounders always talked about. I'd forgotten we smelled the same.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>The old man said this was my only use: to make the Overground swine open their doors. And they did.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>...They were kind to me.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Rustfire Worker B
steps.content: Doni wrapped up the first round. Final meeting's next week. Things are looking good for us!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Worker C
steps.content: Don't get comfortable. Nirvana didn't like any of it. Who knows what they're planning? Double the patrols in the mine. Watch for anything odd.

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: We're on it, we're on it. Got eyes everywhere—even the kids are on lookout. Nobody's slacking. Even this little one new here knows the job.
<i><color=#7683a2>He clapped my shoulder. Called me one of them.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: Rustfire's carrying the whole West District's hope. We won't lose to anybody. Right, kid?
<i><color=#7683a2>The Overground people were happy. Hopeful for a bright future ahead. They wanted me to celebrate with them. They were kind.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>They didn't know my real "mission."</color><i>

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: Map's set. Duty roster and keys are ours. Good work, runt. Knew I had an eye for talent. You're a real piece of work. Your reward's waiting back home. Hahaha.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: "We humans should... help each other... especially a child... we can't leg—leave them... to die."

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: "Humanity... great..." Pfft— HAHAHAHAHAHA!!!

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: They're priceless! Once we plant the inheritance in the mine tonight, our job's done. Then... let's see what those swine dig up when they start tearing each other apart. Heh. They'll never know what hit them.
<i><color=#7683a2>I had completed the task they gave me, but I didn't feel happy at all.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>I didn't understand their plan, but I felt a deep, cold dread.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: What... do you want in the mine?

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: ...To confirm the prophecy's truth. To prove the divine power. To recreate a miracle.

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: ...Recreate... a miracle?

<i><color=#7683a2>I learned the truth later. A seed called the "inheritance" was buried in Mine W-31. The Underground believers wanted to recreate the amusement park's miracle. To prove it could happen anywhere, through devotion alone.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>They succeeded.</color><i>

<color=#fb9259><size=50>November 28, N.F. 104

Inner Bay Mine W-31, the BR-002 (First) Outbreak</color>

<color=#7683a2>[9th Agency Top-Secret Archive Excerpt-3]
EDGE's analysis of pre-outbreak data from Mine W-31 confirmed the presence of an unidentified Mania substance, which matched the signature of the Underground object known as "the inheritance." This signature was later identified at the BR-003 and BR-004 sites. The N.F. 104 incident provided EDGE with its first empirical confirmation of the inheritance's true threat potential. The vector of its introduction into Mine W-31, however, remains officially undetermined.

Following the reconstruction of the West District, authorities restored relations with Rustfire. But most witnesses to the W-31 incident are now deceased, leaving no conclusive evidence as to how the Underground breached security and brought the inheritance into the mine.

<color=#7683a2>Hypnosis conducted on S-247 has recovered fragmented information. Analysis suggests the Underground used a child to gain the workers' trust, and that S-247 participated in this operation, sustaining significant trauma within the Ring...
This hypothesis provides a plausible explanation for his subsequent extreme actions to sever ties with the Underground. Furthermore, his prior familiarity with BR-002 likely influenced his later assignment to surveillance and experimental duties. However, notable inconsistencies remain within the timeline of events described in his account.

<color=#7683a2>The final report determined that his narrative could be attributed to symptoms of a memory disorder, or that this Underground entity was still attempting to deceive us. Consequently, his account was ruled inadmissible as evidence.
Time might be disordered. Memory might become jumbled. Even emotions might be fabricated. But when it came to the Black Rings, everything was absolute.
From the first moment he truly stepped inside a Black Ring, every event was seared into his memory, undimmed to this day.

steps.speaker: Corpus 002
steps.content: ROARRRR—

The black casket had consumed human hearts and birthed monsters. It devoured every struggling worker, swelling endlessly. If a mere human caught a glimpse of it, the fear in their heart would tear open into a bloody maw, devouring them alive before fusing them into its flesh.
Yet, in that bloody hell, it was only a temporary master. Above the Black Ring, a true monster lurked.
[Transition, fade in Sister's portrait, hold for 2 seconds]

steps.speaker: Shepherd???
steps.content: Heh... Look at you, so satisfied after your little feast. Full now?

steps.speaker: Shepherd???
steps.content: Now, it's my turn.

steps.speaker: Halved Corpus
steps.content: ROARRRR—!!

With a thunderous roar, a colossal crimson light sheared the Corpus in half at the waist. Instantly, the abyss found its new master, and the world snapped into terrible clarity. There was the sky's light, the crimson Illusory Moon, and silhouetted against it, a minute figure.
She was Death incarnate, beyond all things. Her very manifestation maddened every faithful soul who had remained to witness the miracle.

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: We did it... We did it!! The sacrifice has been awakened and offered to the Shepherd! She draws closer to godhood!

steps.speaker: Underground Scout
steps.content: Please, transcend all that exists! I... have no regrets in this life!

steps.speaker: Halved Corpus
steps.content: Roarrrr!! DIEEEE!

The sacrifice, now reduced to half a body, was driven by an astonishing will to survive. It must live. It must escape the terrifying monster looming above. It would devour anything it could on its desperate flight—it must survive. Its gaze fell upon the ant-like followers at its feet.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Is it my turn now? Hehe... To become a part of her... I... have no regrets.

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: ...No... NOOO!!
Someone grabbed the old man around the waist, tackling him aside as the deadly blow narrowly missed its mark.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Brat, you—?!!

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: They want you dead! I won't let them!!

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: We have to live! Everyone has to live! Don't let it eat you! Don't die here! I—
Words failed him. His mind was chaos, his body a crucible of rapid mutation. Only one thought burned through the storm:

It was happening again. That hideous crimson halo was coming to take everything from him, a second time. He refused. He would not die here. In response, his corrupted flesh began to unnaturally coalesce, forging a new power that allowed him to take away anyone he hoped to save.
Back then, he still hadn't understood that people could hold vastly different "stances."

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: You... It was you... You led them here... Kid... who are you?

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: A Nirvana spy?!!
Schlick—

steps.speaker: Child in the Memory
steps.content: ...Cough!

Driven by Mania, the miner drove his iron pickaxe deep into the boy's neck, puncturing vital tissue. At eight years old, he encountered his first genuine "death." As the countless hateful gazes bore down on him—a moment etched permanently into his memory—he grasped his position for the first time, and with it, his identity.
Agent, mole, spy... or, stripped to its vilest essence: traitor.
He had it coming.
<i>That was the second Black Ring I witnessed. I should have died there. But I didn't.<i>
<i>I survived, in the most unnatural way.<i>
[Scene Change: Background 953]

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: His condition stabilized? Heh... the experiment actually worked. So even inferior believers who fall short of Parma's caliber can withstand the Ring's blessing...

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: Hm. Could it be because he was already altered inside the Ring? Become what they call a "Sinner"? An excellent finding. Our potential just expanded...
<i><color=#7683a2>Who...? What did you... do to me...?</color><i>

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: Give thanks to fate, brat. You weren't even qualified for the "experiment." But it took pity... and someone offered a sacrifice to place you upon the altar.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Esteemed Priest... I beg you, please, save him! He can still be saved, can't he? The same happened with Lord Parma, didn't it? He survived again and again...!

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: That man claimed the Second Black Ring was all your doing. Said you were willing to offer yourself for the miracle. That one day, you would serve it like Lord Parma... He offered his own arm to prove his loyalty. Heh.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: He's no Overground swine! He only wore their stench to infiltrate them! He's clever! Devout! Sings the hymns every day—every single day! He guarded the inheritance with his life. That's how he was stabbed!

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: He's still young! He'll... he'll be of greater use in the future, I swear! Save him! I'll offer my arm... my whole body if you ask! Please!

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: From now on, you are a reserve of the execution squad. Go. Prove your ability... and your devotion.

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: Don't let us discover your <color=#fb9259>grandfather</color> dared to lie to a priest.
[Scene Change: Underground Space (202 color change)]

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: ...What are you staring at? This arm had been acting up for years. Good riddance.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Don't keep coming back here. You've been blessed with a miracle, accepted into ■■. Don't you have training? You were born low, and even with a new body, they'll still call you an "Overground swine." Sharpen your skills, or they'll toss you back down here.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: ...The priest says the next Black Ring will be larger. More critical. It will take a decade to prepare... By the time you return to the Overground, you'll be grown. Not just a scout anymore. You'll be frontline.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Make something of yourself, brat. The sky's the limit...
...There will be another one?

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Of course.
Without hesitation, the old man gave his answer. The fanaticism in his eyes burned brighter than ever as he gazed with eager, heartfelt sincerity at his reborn "family."

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Don't hold me back next time. Just watch your own back. To die within a Ring... would be my highest honor. It spared me because it values my devotion, giving me another chance to offer myself.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Don't waste your worry on me. Focus on your training and studies. I'll manage just fine with one arm.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: When the next Black Ring descends, I'll be right there with you.
...Okay. I'll wait.

He waited, studying the most deranged sorcery and following the most fanatical Sophos. One by one, those around him were granted revelation, achieved epiphany, or found their release. Yet the "awakening" the faithful promised never arrived for him.
He understood nothing of their fanaticism, their hatred, or their sacrifice. And in the sunless depths, he simply waited, while the twisted time slowly crawled into its tenth year.

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: The time has come. Steel yourself; this will be a brutal struggle. Even the Overground swine must have learned something from the last miracle.

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.content: But it matters not. We have prepared far longer than they have. Time is on our side. And besides... the swine always find a way to tear themselves apart.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: Move out. Ten years... this is the moment we've waited for.
He waited, until he accepted the sacred mission. Yet the promised awakening still eluded him. That steadfast faith had never arrived.
In its place, he had found only doubt, accumulated over years of hollow waiting. And that doubt... led the faithless into shadow. There, he found others of ignoble mind.
[Scene Change: Use any new underground contamination background]

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: ...Heh. What I'm planning is a death sentence. Never thought anyone else would be stupid enough to join.

steps.speaker: Bai Yi
steps.content: You ready to die?

<color=#7683a2>[9th Agency Top-Secret Archive Excerpt-4]

In N.F. 106, during a post-battle sweep of the Navigator Observatory ruins, operatives from the 9th Agency located the sole surviving Underground entity within a contaminated sector.
Designated S-247, he was retrieved for experimental analysis to pinpoint vulnerabilities in Parma-like entities. The project resulted in substantial breakthroughs.

<color=#7683a2>EDGE analysis indicates the Mania corrupting S-247 contains multiple distinct consciousnesses.
The Underground likely used a method to bind these consciousnesses together within his body, with the Black Rings enhancing the effect. This may explain the notorious resilience of certain Underground elites; until all entangled consciousnesses are depleted, they can regenerate via the Black Rings.

Further experiments reveal a key difference from chaotic polymer forms like Parma: S-247's consciousness aggregate is dominated by a single primary will, which suppresses all other chaotic elements. He appears to have undergone a profound transformation within BR-003, achieving a unique equilibrium with his Sinner physiology.

<color=#7683a2>Undoubtedly, he is a twisted creation of the Underground. During the 83rd round of experiments, the Research Institute accidentally pushed Subject S-247's fragile body to the brink of collapse. Following assessment, they recommend immediate disposal to eliminate future risk.

How he had survived was lost to him. During that chaos, he had withstood intense contamination from the Black Ring, weathered frantic assaults from the "Overgrounders," and endured the sheer fury of the Underground's Mania sorcery. Still, he had lived.
Could even this be a blessing from the Black Rings? The notion that he, as one of its blessed, would always be protected and cling to life? What a laughable thought.
<i><color=#7683a2>No matter. We succeeded. At least the Black Ring was taken away, never falling into that woman's hands. The prophecy was wrong. Their efforts were for nothing...</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>Heh... A failure doesn't deserve to be called a god. She was never a god, only a monster. The people of ■■ will awaken. The lies end here. The sacrifices end here.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>Next time, he will do it again. As many times as it takes, he will stand in their way. This is his true purpose.</color><i>

<color=#7683a2>However, Langley Blackett of the 9th Agency offered him a chance: an experiment.
She would transfer the Underground creation into a new, more "reliable" body, testing whether the vessel could influence his humanity. Concurrently, the process would serve as a stress test for her own Sinner power.

Success would yield a potent weapon against the Underground and the Black Rings, permissible under heavy surveillance.
Failure, conversely, would measure her Causality's efficacy against such Underground entities.

In her assessment, the odds favored the former.

<color=#7683a2>The evidence was written on his broken form. Found in a wretched state, S-247 bore the marks of dozens of lethal Underground sorceries, his life nearly extinguished by them. And the final proof lay strewn around him: the bodies of his former kin.

Regardless of his past, this defector had drawn his line, in blood.
The slaughter was finally over. He could no longer remember how many times he had died, nor how many he had slain. It no longer mattered. He won. Now, time to celebrate.

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: I should never have saved you! Not once, never! I should've let you die right there! I should've killed you myself!!

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: How could you do this?! You are my—
<i><color=#7683a2>Maybe it's better this way. No more hesitation. No regret. Just forward, with no way back.</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>Everything, after all these years, comes down to this one answer: the only true faith for a man who believes in nothing.</color><i>
Urgh... AAAAHHH—!!

steps.speaker: The 9th Agency Report
steps.content: From that day on, he became the Underground's mortal enemy.

<color=#fb9259><size=50>N.F. 106
Navigator Observatory - Surface Ruins</color>
<i>The third Black Ring. And still, I'm alive.<i>
<i>Though... this might be what death feels like, anyway.<i>
His memories were adrift, scattering and sinking in a disordered tide. Only those anchored to the Black Rings remained constant.
How he wished he could tell ${PlayerName}. The vigilance he had once upheld was now matched by a desperate hope: that ${PlayerName} might glimpse the truth through the shackles.
—With these thoughts filling his mind, he opened his eyes. In the silence, shadows drew near, pulling him back from his memory.

N.F. 115
The Rust
A handful of Underground assassins emerge from the shadows, silent puppets at their heels. Only one steps forward to speak.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: ...Arrogant as ever. You still dare to come here.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But of course. You are the very reason I cling to this wretched existence.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Shouldn't you all be minding the Third Black Ring now? I'm touched you'd make time for me.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: You interfered... You leaked our intelligence to the Overground. Uprooted the seeds we'd sown. Years of planning, undone because of you.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: You created risks where there should have been none.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh. Well, I did learn from the best.

He is ready for a fight; he always knew they would come. Just as he understands the Underground, his old friends from there understand him just as well. They know he always returns to where it all began.

Can he win? Hard to say. This body’s been put through too much; it’s close to its limit. If he dies… at least the shackles on him will finally break.. Might even spare that person the trouble of worrying and chasing after him every day.
At least he has said everything. He has readied himself for battle, coming back to life once again to take his place at the gambling table.
Then, his foe speaks, and the words stop him cold.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: ...You could still come back.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Back to where?

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Home.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: There are those willing to plead your case before the priest. Even the Sage has agreed to hear you out... All you have to do is come back.
[Scene Change: MBCC]

A calculated interference drowns out the shackles' connection. Your search leads you from one empty location to the next, only to find pieces of flesh he left behind. By the time the emergency transmission from the monitoring station reaches you, far too much time has already passed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not BR-005... He's near the Rust? Same fluctuation pattern as last time?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see. I'm on my way! To the BR-001 ruins, now!
[The Ruins]
Time itself appears to freeze within the ruins. The churning roar of the contamination nearly drowns out the memory of that whispered offer.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Why would you want me back? I'm not exactly a free man now.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Besides, I thought your creed had no room for forgiveness. For traitors, least of all.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Did you tell them where the Holy City lies? Did you sell the Shepherd's secrets?

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: ...Exactly. Those wretches have not found the gate to ■■. Not a single believer has fallen by your hand... That proves your conscience is not entirely lost.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: The Third Black Ring was the work of that Bai woman. You were deceived. Captured by that Spider, tortured, brainwashed... They caged you in a body not your own, tried to twist your faith with a swine's memories, and forced you to dance on their strings.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Even then, you did not sell out your kin... That is why some of us cannot bring ourselves to forsake you.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Many remember what you sacrificed for us. Many refuse to let that memory die. Cutting you loose... proved more difficult than we thought.
<i><color=#7683a2>...Don't say that.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: We already killed you once. Shattered that filthy puppet-shell; broke the Spider's chains. The role is over. Will you not finally wake up?

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Cast off the memories that fog your mind. Reclaim your faith. The Underground shows no mercy to traitors, but you're different.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: You were merely led astray. Blinded by base instinct, by sentiment... It is... understandable. We can look past that.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Every misstep you took was born from love for them.
<i><color=#7683a2>...You never cared.</color><i>

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: The Third Black Ring is no longer hidden. Our Shepherd's power grows, and the Sages are prepared. When the moment comes, <color=#fb9259>she</color> will rise from the Underground and scour the world clean of all opposition.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: Come back. It is not too late to atone. Serve, redeem yourself, and walk the path of greatness once more. The Holy City will receive you. Return to ■■, or at least to the old man's side.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder
steps.content: He remembers little now. But he still asks for you.
It's a trap. He knows this all too well. They repeat the same lines every time, each one a blade aimed at the same exposed nerve.
...And yet, how he loathes it.
His pulse thunders in his ears. His voice speaks before his mind can intervene, repeating the same futile, damning question yet again.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...If I went back... what awaits me?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Are you all still down in that hole, lining up to offer yourselves to the Black Rings... to her?
The figure before him offers no answer, only lifting their chin in haughty pride.
Of course. About this, at least, they never lie.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Hah. Damn it all.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It sure sounds like home...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Ugh... Stubborn fools are the worst!

steps.speaker: Undergrounder C
steps.content: Argh!

This is a strike years in the making. His hesitation ends; his resolve snaps forward with a speed his foe could never predict. Though they share the same resilient curse, Rust holds the darker pedigree—he has died more times and been reforged more cruelly in the Black Rings' endless agony. In that fleeting advantage, the traitor's attack finds its mark in the old friend's chest.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder C
steps.content: Fool... This chance we fought to give you, and you—

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I've worn too many skins to remember who you are. My apologies.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The Black Rings' <color=#fb9259>blessing</color> is the only reason I'm still breathing. So you see... that leaves me with just one simple purpose in life.

The thought of that face tightens Rust's grip. He unleashes a deeper, hungrier power. Why merely kill and let his foe collect a prize from the Black Rings again? True mercy is a cleaner end: to consume him utterly—flesh, spirit, all of it—leaving nothing to return.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You were so eager to throw your lives away. Might as well die by my hand. Consider it your final contribution to the Black Rings. A noble sacrifice, wouldn't you agree?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Now, now, don't look at me like that. You know what I am.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I'm used to it by now.
He ignites the Mania within. The zealot's form liquefies under its heat, and the molten residue is absorbed into Rust's being.

steps.speaker: Undergrounder C
steps.content: Heh... Hehehe... She will come soon... bearing the shackles of rebirth... to guide us toward transcendence...

steps.speaker: Undergrounder C
steps.content: But you... You...

steps.speaker: Interwoven Memories
steps.content: Traitor!! Ungrateful wretch!! Blasphemous vermin!!!

Their venomous curses wash over him like a balm. Yes, this is for the best. Give him no room to question, no reason to falter. He has chosen to be a traitor, and their hatred is the finest prize he can collect. No matter how many bodies he wears or whose memories tangle with his own, that will never change.
At last, Rust dissolves the man's consciousness and flesh, imprisoning and plundering everything he once was. The killing is complete, sealed with an embrace.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Rest here... Don't go to that place. Don't become fodder for monsters...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You have made it far enough...

He lays down the only remaining raincoat and buries it in a shallow grave. The night falls quiet once more. He has bestowed death upon an unfortunate old friend, and lived on himself, again. And now...
It is time to bear the madness the dead have left behind.

steps.speaker: Mine Guard
steps.content: Bastard... Traitor... You're the one who should be dead... Die with us...

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: May the Mania consume you... May the Black Rings claim you... And I... I curse you forever...

steps.speaker: Underground Elder
steps.content: In life and death, may you never know peace...

It is always like this. New flesh and blood, once absorbed, shatter the delicate equilibrium inside him. His consciousness tears apart, only to be crudely kneaded back together—a bloody, aberrant mess that plunges him into brief, howling chaos.

Dying and returning to the Black Rings now would be such a waste... This vessel hasn't given out yet. Stubborn thing. Might as well push it a little further. It's not my first time being hunted. No room for sentiment.
He staggers upright, willing his leaden legs to carry him on.
As long as I'm breathing, I have a role to play. The choice was made long ago. No turning back now. Keep moving. See it through... There's only this one path I can take, anyway...
Someone else is coming, and they look familiar... An old friend, perhaps?

steps.speaker: Thorn"?
steps.content: ...That Undergrounder again?! Chief! Be careful!!
Ah... A gun rises in the newcomer's hand, its aim steady on his chest. Another life-taker, then. Yet a strange familiarity washes over Rust, and without thinking, his shoulders loosen.

steps.speaker: Blurred Figure
steps.content: Hold on, don't shoot! He's not an enemy!
A second blurred shape pushes down the raised gun. In a frantic rush, they close the distance and grasp his hand—so rotten that it's seeping with contamination.

steps.speaker: Blurred Figure
steps.content: Rust, are you alright? Just hang on, I can help you. The shackles might stabilize your condition. Let me try, okay?
[Release the shackles]
A red light drives into him, an unexpected warmth laced with calm, power, and an unshakeable will. If anything in this world can tear apart a body cursed by the Black Rings, this is surely it.
But wait... Wake up. He should know this. He must remember who the master of this power is.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...The shackles...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You're... the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color>...
The blurred shape in front of him sharpens into clarity. There. This is the end he has chased across a lifetime. The single purpose for which he has refused to die.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Shepherd???
steps.content: ...Good. The "shackles" have been well-fed. One step closer to your "god"...

steps.speaker: Shepherd???
steps.content: Congratulations. Your sacrifices weren't in vain.
[Exit Flashback]
Rust smiles, dazed, and slowly closes his hand around the one extended toward him.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Finally... I found you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ngh—!!

steps.speaker: Thorn"?
steps.content: Chief?!
His hand closes over yours. His living flesh spreads rapidly, a warm, invasive weave across your skin. You feel it burrowing into your veins, a current of death rushing toward your mind.
You look down and meet his eyes. Rust's smile is sincere, his crimson gaze holding yours with an absolute, fervent resolve. It is not hate that burns there, but something far more consuming.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It's because of you... They're all so stubborn because of you...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: As long as you're alive, nothing can change... So...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I've waited so long for this. Can you please just die?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, you—

Does he not feel it? Even as he corrupts you, the color drains rapidly from his own flesh. His life is bleeding away. The shackles have instinctively triggered their protection. Every inch closer he presses only drives him further onto Death's scythe.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Please... just die...
His voice fades, yet his hold on your hand is unyielding. He clings to you, to the very shackles burning in your palm, and with a desperate stubbornness, draws you nearer.

You shout the restraining order. Spikes of light rip through his already shattered body once more. He coughs up blood, yet his smile only widens. His grip is not relenting, pulling you ever closer. The crimson spike from your palm is already buried in his chest.
And through the shackles, his consciousness touches yours again. From somewhere deep within the chaos, you hear a faint voice.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: <size=30>Now... I can finally... die...
In that single, shattering moment, you finally see his true purpose. And then... pure, unthinking fury takes you.
[Release the shackles]
<i><color=#7683a2>This is it, then?</color><i>
<i><color=#7683a2>...Finally.</color><i>
